definitions.explanation: A machine-readable code consisting of a pattern of black and white squares that can store more information than a traditional one-dimensional barcode. Commonly used for payments, ticketing, and quick access to websites.

examples.japanese: {二次元|にじげん}コードを{読|よ}み{取|と}る。
スマホで{二次元|にじげん}コードを{読|よ}み{込|こ}んでください。
examples.english: Please scan the QR code with your smartphone.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}いは{二次元|にじげん}コード{決済|けっさい}が{便利|べんり}です。
examples.english: QR-code payment is convenient for payments.

examples.japanese: このチラシの{二次元|にじげん}コードから{詳|くわ}しい{情報|じょうほう}にアクセスできます。
examples.english: You can access detailed information from the QR code on this flyer.

notes:
A formal/official term for what is commonly called a QR code. Composed of {二次元|にじげん} (two-dimensional) + コード (code). The term {二次元|にじげん}コード is often preferred in formal writing, government documents, and printed materials because "QR code" is a registered trademark of Denso Wave, though QRコード is also widely used in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二次元|にじげん}コードを{読|よ}み{取|と}る: to scan/read a QR code
- {二次元|にじげん}コードを{読|よ}み{込|こ}む: to scan a QR code (into a device)
- {二次元|にじげん}コード{決済|けっさい}: QR-code payment
- {二次元|にじげん}コード{付|つ}き: with a QR code attached
- {二次元|にじげん}コードを{生成|せいせい}する: to generate a QR code

SIMILAR WORDS:
- QRコード: QR code — the common everyday term; same thing
- バーコード: barcode — one-dimensional linear barcode (stripes only)
- {一次元|いちじげん}コード: one-dimensional code — the formal counterpart term for traditional barcodes

USAGE:
QR codes are extremely widespread in Japan, used for cashless payment systems (PayPay, LINE Pay, etc.), restaurant menus, event tickets, transit, and advertisements.
